hero:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design a polished production website for the real Almaty air-conditioning company SILVER CLIMAT. Russian language. Crisp architectural editorial design, true white #ffffff and pale cool mint #f2f7f4, very dark forest #173e32, accent lime #d7ef8d. Modern geometric sans serif with expressive large headings, clean 1px rules, buttons 8px corners, 72px gutters in 1440px frame. Quiet elegant design, ample whitespace, no pills/badges/eyebrows above hero, no fake statistics/testimonials/prices/certifications, no dashboard, no giant rounded wrapper. Code-native real text and controls in implementation. Four coherent major surfaces are designed separately. All screenshots must have readable text. Logo is a simple typographic SILVER CLIMAT wordmark with a small vector airflow symbol. Header nav: Каталог, Монтаж и сервис, Контакты. Primary action: Подобрать кондиционер. Real contact +7 707 347 19 74. Practical HTML/CSS layout.
Desktop first viewport, exactly 1440x1000 composition. White slim header, wordmark left, nav middle, phone and small green arrow action right. Below header a two-column open hero. Left 44% with huge dark-green heading in exactly three lines: "Климат,\nв котором\nхочется жить." 82px lettering. Under it readable copy "Кондиционеры для дома и бизнеса. Подбор, установка и сервис в Алматы и области." Two actions: dark forest button "Подобрать кондиционер" and text link "Смотреть каталог". Small bottom text "Поможем разобраться в моделях и выбрать своё." Right 56% large beautiful photo: quiet contemporary light apartment, pale green-gray wall, elegant white wall AC high on wall, rounded pale sofa, olive tree, sun casting gentle window shadow, tactile natural materials, no people, no visible brand. Image frame has round upper left 100px and lower right 100px, other corners 8px. No overlays, no text on photo. Under hero white horizontal brand wordmarks ALMACOM / GREE / LG / SAMSUNG / OTEX divided from next section by rule. Layout should feel expensive, fresh and specific to home climate.
